skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and master basic knowledge about healthcare, including its necessity and role, healthcare service delivery system, and financing sources.
Analyze and evaluate the role of health insurance within the healthcare system.
Understand and master the basics of social health insurance, including its concept, characteristics, coverage, benefits, funding sources, and implementation.
Understand and master the basics of commercial health insurance, including its concept, characteristics, coverage, benefits, funding sources, and implementation.
Analyze and evaluate healthcare financing models and health insurance systems in various countries.
Develop group work skills, independent working ability, logical thinking, critical thinking, legal understanding, law compliance, responsibility, leadership, and community engagement.
Develop self-learning ability, independent working ability, logical thinking, critical thinking, legal understanding, law compliance, responsibility, leadership, and community engagement.
